acceptedClaims: source-backed GPIO14 ownership/route preflight register identity
local/static real candidate performs only the contracted read-only GPIO14 ownership/route preflight loads
paired no-MMIO/no-RP1/no-GIC control candidate constructs no forbidden RP1/GIC/MSI-X/PCIe/MIP/GPIO/pads/RIO/clock-reset MMIO path

GPIO CTRL, IO_BANK0 INTE, RIO, or pad writes

findings.summary: Closed source/core/control/real proof chain as a read-only GPIO14 ownership/route preflight frontier with a retained blocker.
Recorded paired no-MMIO/no-RP1/no-GIC control proof as satisfied before the real Pi 5 preflight proof.
Retained rejected first real run, known-good control, and decisive rerun as capture hygiene evidence while accepting only the decisive identity-joined rerun.
Updated roadmap and project contract docs for the accepted blocker frontier.

Event-generation or pending-generation retry requires new supervisor planning around GPIO14 ownership/function selection, parent-route masking, deterministic event source, partial-write recovery, and restore semantics.
Raw 0xdeaddead snapshot values are treated only as visible read-only diagnostic data, not as GPIO ownership, event generation, delivery, or handler ownership.

nextAction: Set planningNeeded=true for supervisor planning of the next Milestone 11.2 feature slice; do not create same-shaped GPIO ownership/route preflight, event-latch, or event-generation hardware rerun tasks without a different discriminator or new acceptance criteria.
